text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Change in CRPS, mean of 10 seeds, 8 refit months. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval over seeds. Host rows are split by whether the injected engine runs at the valid time. At D8 the rows are split by season, because the real engine fades from March.'
text.tspan: Change in CRPS, mean of 10 seeds, 8 refit months. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval over
seeds. Host rows are split by whether the injected engine runs at the valid time.
At D8 the rows are split by season, because the real engine fades from March.
